verticalReference: Unmodified elevations from the published source DEM; no Earth datum conversion
layout: row-major, rows north to south, columns west to east
interpolation: Sample coordinates are native pixel centres; any browser bilinear interpolation is a derived display/camera height, not a finer observation

source.credit: NASA MRO HiRISE / Caltech; Annex & Ehlmann (2024)
source.processing: Existing native 1 m crop copied into little-endian Float32; no spatial resampling, terrain synthesis or vertical exaggeration

opticalReference.processing: Existing contrast-stretched, bilinear 1 m display resampling; native approximately 0.3 m observations are not all retained in this display asset
opticalReference.annotationLimit: Individual sub-display-pixel objects cannot be verified from this WebP; manual annotations are observations/candidates, not validated boulder classifications

limitations: Native pixel spacing is not vertical accuracy or registration accuracy. Observation dates and inter-product registration error remain unknown. Heights do not resolve all small rocks or establish walkability.
